verdict.rationale: The MI355X is a datacenter GPU accelerator with its ROCm software stack, not an application that analyzes user data and surfaces AI-generated insights to the user, so this story does not fit the product type. Nothing in the evidence shows such a feature shipping. The 'AI-native' Spur scheduler is a GPU-first Slurm-compatible scheduler, not an insights feature, and the monitoring tools (AMD SMI, Prometheus metrics exporter) only expose raw metrics.
